description.en: Instantly swaps a screen's brightness between two states (e.g. black and normal), rather than fading it over time like CMND_BRIGHT_FADE.
Which screen to update, e.g. SCREEN_A.

A floating-point value (likely the screen's resulting/previous brightness level) once applied; null if the call was invalid (fewer than 2 arguments). The exact source of the pushed float could not be fully resolved from the decompiled code.

example.code:
// Instantly swap the top screen's brightness state
CMND_BRIGHT_SWAP(SCREEN_A, true, true);
